name: Страж Разлома
subject: A towering fallen fantasy knight with violet-gray broad iron plate armor, pale cubic mask with narrow violet eyes, a stepped spiked CROWN, large chunky pale-lavender crystal shoulder pauldrons, dark plum rectangular torn cape. CHARACTER RIGHT hand holds ONE large straight stepped pale-silver GREATBLADE downward, inset violet strip through the actual blade centre, grip/guard/blade one aligned connected construction. CHARACTER LEFT hand holds ONE broad physical violet-gray kite shield with a lavender crystal boss and thick metal edging. Front greatblade viewer LEFT and shield viewer RIGHT; back blade viewer RIGHT, shield viewer LEFT. Isometric faces lower LEFT so shield-bearing LEFT arm is nearest viewer on image RIGHT. Equipment assignment consistent; backside of shield has handle straps, not front crystal emblem. No extra sword, horns, levitation, aura, energy slash or tiny shards.
caption: Пять ракурсов босса в крупной воксельной стилистике; развитие существующего силуэта и палитры.
